brief:
Australian political leaders have criticised pro-Palestine vigils scheduled for the third anniversary of the October 7 attacks, The Guardian reported. Peak Jewish bodies are organising ceremonies to commemorate the date that triggered the current conflict, in which 74,000 Palestinians have been killed according to health officials in Gaza.

The timing of competing commemorations has prompted condemnation from Australian officials over plans to hold pro-Palestine events on the same day as Jewish memorial services.
